routes.serves: note list JSON that feeds the home page notes area (pinned notes and regular notes)
create a note from the Take a note editor (title + content); returns 201 with the created note, 400 on invalid JSON body
update an existing note's title/content; returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist, 400 on invalid JSON body
soft-delete a note (moves it to the Trash); returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
restore a deleted note from the Trash; returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
archive a note from the note actions area (body {archived:false} unarchives it, used by the Undo action); returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist
pin or unpin a note (body {pinned:false} unpins); returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when missing
permanently delete a note (used by the Trash view)
empty the trash (permanently remove every deleted note)

notes: REQ-2.5.1 reuses the existing POST /api/notes/:id/archive route (added for the archive view). Clicking the Archive action button on a note card archives the note (archived=true), moves it out of the home notes list, and shows a snackbar notification 'Note archived' with an Undo action that posts {archived:false} to the same route and restores the note. The seed contains an active note 'Travel plans 2.5.1' (content 'Archive workflow note'). The sidebar is collapsed by default (opened via the Main menu button) so the note card's Archive action is the only /archive/i button in the accessibility tree while on the home page - the sidebar Archive nav item must stay reachable for the archive view (REQ-2.5.3/2.5.4 use openSidebar, which clicks Main menu first).
